CheckVersion.description: The version of a model check report, its `schema` field.

Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

description:
The report of `crn-craft check MODEL [REQUEST]`: `crn-craft.check/1.0`, with the fields of `crn-craft.rules-check/0.1` and `run_sha256`. It is reported for a `crn-craft.model/1.0` document, for a network `crn-craft.model/0.1` (checked by converting it) and for any model with a request (whether `crn-craft run` would accept the two documents).

The check stops at the first stage that fails (parsing, size limits, names and types, then the rest of the model, then the request), so `diagnostics` lists the errors of that stage.

diagnostics.description: Errors with stable codes and JSON Pointer paths: `CRN-E001` to `CRN-E004` from parsing, `CRN-R010` to `CRN-R016` and `CRN-E033` from the model, `CRN-E030` for an unreadable file, and with a request the errors `crn-craft run` would report before running (`CRN-R020`, `CRN-R017`, ...), with paths into the request or the model.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model bytes, when they could be read.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the request bytes, when a request was checked (`crn-craft.check/1.0` only; absent otherwise).

valid.description: True when the model parses and compiles without diagnostics.

title: RulesCheck
